cmd.fn: async () => { const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.offsetParent && /figure it out/i.test(x.textContent)); if (b) b.click(); const mg = window.MinigameFramework; if (mg && mg.currentMinigame) { try { mg.endMinigame(false); } catch (e) {} } await w(250); } return 1; }

() => { const g = window.gameState.globalVariables; g.clone_call_done = true; g.mission_phase = 'act2_infiltration'; document.head.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', '<style>.objectives-panel,#notification-container,.notification,#npc-bark-container,.npc-interaction-prompt,.phone-access-button,#health-ui-container,#hud-info-label,#toggle-buttons-container,#inventory-container,#scenario-timer-display,#music-widget-btn-anchor{display:none!important}</style>'); const d = window.npcManager.npcs.get('danny_foster'); return 1; }

async () => { const R = "reception_lobby", patch = {"room": "reception_lobby", "variant": {}}, cam_on = null; const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); if (!window.rooms[R]) await window.loadRoom(R); const d = window.npcManager.npcs.get('danny_foster'); if (d && d._sprite) d._sprite.setVisible(true); const L = window.lightingSystem; const s = L.rooms.get(R); if (!s.origBlock) s.origBlock = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s.block)); const b = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s.origBlock)); if (patch.variant) Object.assign(b.variants[0], patch.variant); if (patch.emitters) b.variants[0].emitters = Object.assign({}, b.variants[0].emitters || {}, patch.emitters); s.block = b; s.variantIdx = -99; s.lastRoomResolve = 0; await w(700); const r = window.rooms[cam_on || R]; const cam = L.scene.cameras.main; cam.stopFollow(); cam.centerOn(r.position.x + r.map.widthInPixels / 2, r.position.y + r.map.heightInPixels / 2); await w(500); return s.mode + ' v' + s.variantIdx + ' #' + s.litAmbient.toString(16); }
